verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs show spend management (cards, auto-receipts, expense coding), end-to-end bill pay, and business banking (checking and investment accounts, ACH and wires) in one product, plus a customer case of replacing 4 tools. Banking is US-only and delivered through partner banks, since Ramp is not itself a bank. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of consolidating separate tools (community evidence covers only expense cards), and coverage beyond US-only banking.

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform
